findings.title: Implementation repository is referenced for verifiable claims but is not locatable
findings.evidence: HTTP 404 for https://api.github.com/repos/hobby-eng/mhfe; git log in the implementation tree reports no commits; no repository URL in the specification.
findings.reproduction: Read the Reference Implementation and Test Vectors sections; search the document for a URL to the implementation; query the GitHub API for hobby-eng/mhfe.
findings.expected: Every artifact cited as checkable (ignored replay test, vector CI workflow, measurements/ records, WASM/Worker adapter) is reachable from the published specification, or the text states that the implementation is unpublished.
findings.observed: Statements are true for the local uncommitted mhfe tree (ignore attribute, vectors.yml/release.yml replay, measurement files) but unreachable for readers; Cargo.toml repository URL resolves to nothing.
findings.impact: Readers cannot verify implementation-dependent claims or the interoperability precondition. No technical statement is wrong.
findings.recommendedFix: Publish the implementation and cite its URL and pinned revision in IEEE style; until then state that it is unpublished or move CI/measurement statements to the implementation's documentation.
findings.requiredVerification: URL resolves; cited revision contains the ignored replay test, the vector workflow and the measurements/ files with the quoted values.

observations.title: Independent reproduction now covers both directions of all six vectors
observations.evidence: Scratch Python implementation reproduced forward and inverse permutations, auto-detection, verifier and container mnemonics for all six vectors.
observations.reproduction: Run the independent verifier against vectors/zero-*.json.
observations.expected: Test Vectors section may record that a second independently written implementation reproduced every vector in both directions.
observations.observed: Lines 1970-1976 state only forward-round recalculation plus the Rust generator's own inverse round trip.
observations.recommendedFix: Optional wording update with the caveat that the verifier is a scratch implementation, not a maintained one or a security review.

observations.title: Reference [17] is an attack paper cited among security results
observations.evidence: ePrint 2008/036 abstract: distinguishers on 5 rounds at O(2^n) and on 6-round generators at O(2^2n); recommends at least 6 rounds.
observations.reproduction: Read line 984 and the abstract of [17].
observations.expected: Attribution distinguishes proofs of security ([14], [15], [18]) from generic-attack cost bounds ([17]).
observations.observed: Sentence reads as if all four references prove beyond-birthday security.
observations.impact: Citation precision only; the underlying claim is not wrong because the attack costs exceed the birthday scale.
observations.recommendedFix: Add a clause such as '[17] gives the matching generic-attack costs'.

observations.title: "Balanced Feistel wins when rounds are scarce" refers to Appendix E, Fig. 6
observations.evidence: Hoang-Rogaway text: Fig. 4 'given an adequate number of rounds, imbalance helps'; 'Appendix E, Fig. 6; when rounds are scarce, balanced-Feistel wins'.
observations.reproduction: Compare lines 1804-1808 with the paper's paragraph following Theorem 7.
observations.expected: The 'scarce rounds' clause cites Appendix E, Fig. 6.
observations.observed: Both clauses are attributed to the text accompanying Fig. 4.
observations.impact: Precision only; quoted content is accurate.
observations.recommendedFix: Cite Appendix E, Fig. 6 for the scarce-rounds clause.

observations.title: Header block carries no document date
observations.evidence: Lines 5-15 list Version 0.3.0 without a date; CITATION.cff date-released 2026-09-22; CHANGELOG 0.3.0 (2026-09-22).
observations.expected: A BIP-style header includes an assigned/created or updated date.
observations.observed: Date is available only in companion files.
observations.impact: Copies of the specification cannot be dated without companion files.
observations.recommendedFix: Add the release date to the header block.

remediation.evidence: The public implementation repository and pinned revision links, measurements, vector replay test, and CI workflow resolve from the published specification.

limitations: No cryptanalysis of the construction beyond re-deriving the document's own bounds; MHFE security remains unproven as the document states.
